# Nicholas Chew

> Nicholas Chew is a Singapore-based technology leader, Tech Partner and Chief Technology Officer at Section. He builds technical capabilities, develops leaders and delivers scalable platforms that connect technology decisions to business outcomes.

## Profile

- Role: Tech Partner and Chief Technology Officer at Section
- Location: Singapore
- Focus: technology leadership, enterprise architecture, systems integration, digital experience platforms, cloud architecture and practical enterprise AI
- Leadership: leads a technical organisation of more than 60 people
- Capability building: more than 100 professional certifications earned across over 40 team members

## Selected work

- Sentosa Development Corporation loyalty platform: Technical Lead for the public website and mobile app; nearly one million programme sign-ups over three years.
- Yuanta securities platform: Technical Lead for five application targets, a backend-for-frontend and on-premises architecture covering high availability, scaling, business continuity and disaster recovery considerations.
- SectionSecure: CTO for an application-maintenance platform spanning security testing, code quality, performance, service levels, logs and AI observability; helped grow application-maintenance revenue by 40% year-on-year in its first year through more contract wins.

## Point of view

Nicholas approaches new technical capabilities by learning the platform, proving the first engagement with the team, appointing specialist leadership and handing over ownership once delivery is stable.
